source: My green bow… I thought it was lost… Da and Ma — I remember your voices, your faces, but the world around you is hazy. What would you say about who I've become? “GREAT BANSHEES OF BALOR! You say you run a city, me dear?” Yes, Da, ain’t it grand? Though you'd probably throw a right fit if you knew I named our nearby mountain after the lovely Ms. Vivienne. I’m seen as a great builder, a visionary. But it’s a lie that lives quietly in my heart. The only time I revealed my past — my childhood in Asbury — was to Savyna many years ago, and she thought I was delirious and overworked from Exomnus lessons. The greatest loneliness is being misunderstood. I suppose, at the very least, it’s a fulfilling purpose to help Quent advance so rapidly out of its dusty huts. The completion of the canal from the spring at Mt. Vivienne was key, as it allowed us to irrigate the forest along with vast acres of dusty land. Farmers pointed out that the land was somehow primed to receive water – a vast system of intricate tunnels lay under the surface, likely from insect empires centuries in the making. And then, there was the book… Much of our progress can be credited to the Great Text of Existence. Found six years ago, the one titled Advanced Placement Chemistry: 2016 Edition. Signed by an “Alvin Van Eisen II” – likely a brilliant scholar from the past. Unearthed in the pine woods by Ebned Praetis planting tobacco, the book held immense revelations about the synthesization of earth’s chemicals, allowing us to barrel forward with refined gunpowder, primitive antibiotics, crude ethanol and vegetable oil fuels… But it also opened our eyes to all we still lacked from the ways of the ancients. Digitization of information, theoretical explorations of gravity, advanced medicines, air travel, solar energy, and something truly incredible called the World Wide Web. The amount we have to learn feels immeasurable. Though, knowing that these achievements are possible to recapture leaves half the battle won. Then, of course, the greatest discovery… the one that overshadows all the others. It was hardly two pages within the whole of the Great Text of Existence, but it held the most meaning. Scientists from the past concluded a Human Genome Project in 2003, establishing that all humans are genetically 92% similar! To think… we feel so individual yet our hearts and minds, the very particles that form them, are nearly all the same… I announced the news to the people of Quent, and memorialized the event going forward as “You-Are-Me Day.” “With this knowledge, to be a fool is to lack empathy,” I exclaimed from the steps of the Rotunda Libraria. Rapidly, notions of racism, xenophobism, misogyny, homophobia and the like were publicly ridiculed. The people collectively looked at one another and, more consistently than ever before, considered their spirit in another person’s condition. It’s funny. I read Exomnus scripts about civilization-shaping energies like nuclear fusion. But we are experimenting with a fuel that is far more potent: a shared vision for communal well-being. I’ll continue to test my theory. I have a feeling that a unified people working for each other can advance society at an unmatched pace.
target: 我的绿蝴蝶结……还以为丢了…… 爸、妈，我记得声音与面容，可你们周围的世界模糊了。看我如今模样，会说什么？「巴罗尔的女妖啊！亲爱的，妳说妳管一座城？」 对，爸，很了不起吧？ 不过，要知道我拿可爱的薇薇安小姐命名附近的山，你大概会大发雷霆。 大家视我为伟大建设者、远见者，可那是静藏心底的谎言。唯一一次坦露过去、阿斯伯里的童年，是多年前对莎维娜说。她以为我艾克索姆语课上得太累，神志不清。最大的孤独，是不被理解。至少，帮昆特迅速走出尘土小屋，仍是充实的使命。 薇薇安山泉水渠道完工，是关键，让我们能灌溉森林与大片尘地。农夫说，土地不知为何早已准备迎水，表面下有广大精密的隧道网，大概是昆虫帝国数百年建成。然后，是那本书…… 许多进步，都归功于《存在大典》。六年前找到，书名《大学先修化学：2016 年版》，署名「艾尔文・范艾森二世」，想必是古代杰出学者。艾布内德・普雷蒂斯种烟草时，在松林挖出它。书中合成地球化学物质的重大启示，让精制火药、初阶抗生素、粗制乙醇与植物油燃料飞速发展…… 但它也让我们看清，距古人仍缺多少。资讯数位化、重力理论、先进医药、飞行、太阳能，以及不可思议的全球资讯网。要学的似乎无穷。不过，知道这些成就能重现，就已赢了一半。 当然，还有最伟大的发现……盖过其他所有发现。大典中不到两页，意义却最深。古代科学家于 2003 年完成人类基因组计划，确认所有人类的基因有 92% 相同！想想……我们自觉独特，可心与思想，连构成它们的粒子，几乎全都一样…… 我向昆特百姓宣布，将此事纪念为「你即是我日」。 「有了这知识，缺乏同理心便是愚蠢，」我在圆厅图书馆阶前宣告。种族歧视、仇外、厌女、恐同之类，很快遭公众嘲笑。人们望向彼此，比以往更常设想，自己的灵魂若处于他人境地。 很有趣。我读艾克索姆语文稿，谈核融合等塑造文明的能源。但我们正在试验的燃料，远比那强：对共同福祉的共同愿景。我会继续验证理论。我感觉，团结的人们彼此努力，能以前所未有的速度推进社会。

source:
Structures made of stone slurry. Poured, hardened, rising. Bursting with gardens and vines. Heights surpassing the tallest pines. 

I miss seeing the evergreens. I miss all my horizons. There are no longer views to gaze. The only expanse I see is the sky, slowly disturbed by the towers of smooth stone. Sometimes topped with spinning mills. 

The focused ray of my attention refracts like sunlight through quartz. A wagon contraption puttering with corn fuel. Children playing raiders and soldiers. Above, an old woman hanging sheets. A cat darts around the corner. Then street lights flicker on. Commotion all around.  

Especially today, on You-Are-Me Day, the city’s energy penetrates my fibers. Savyna’s tomb is bedecked with streamers twisted in helix.  

“Swelga, merry you-are-me!” 

“You-are-me to you and yours, Tabor.” 

Perhaps I am no longer what I view myself. I am not quite a tree. But rather, a neighbor among neighbors.

石浆建筑，灌注、硬化、升起，满溢花园藤蔓，比最高松树更高。

我想念常青树，想念每道地平线。再无景可望，只剩天空，却也被光滑石塔慢慢侵入，有时塔顶转着风车。

专注如阳光穿石英，折向各处。玉米燃料车噗噗行走，孩子扮掠夺者与士兵。上方老女人晒床单，猫窜过转角，街灯亮起。四周喧闹。

尤其今天，你即是我日，城市活力穿透纤维。莎维娜墓上，缀满螺旋彩带。

「斯维尔嘉，你即是我日快乐！」

「塔博尔，祝你全家你即是我日快乐。」

也许，我不再是自以为的样子。不太像树，更像邻居之间的一位邻居。

source: Strange old man… Was silent. Found me in the woods. I was rubbing dirt on the pained foot. My eyes met his and I growled hard and showed all my teeth. His eyes got big. Then laughed loudly. He approached slow and I got up to run, but the pained foot could not take weight. He threw me a strip of dried meat. Ahoo! Good flavor! “Eb-ned” he said, hand on his chest. I knew the next hand motion – he beckoned. Turned, walked. I limped after and clutched my gem. No. I did not enter his hut. Ugly woman who hurt me had hut of almost-same shape. I stayed outside on the needles. He brought me cooked eggs and meat. Ahooooo! Never had egg and meat this good! No hair on meat, no shell in egg! Salt …mysterious herbs! Ahooo! Next he brought out a bowl of warm water with a woven rag. Motioned his idea: put foot in water, scrub with rag. Then he went inside. Now the strange old man snores and sleeps. He is not afraid? Does he not know I can hurt him? His home smells like leathery-smoke. A small fire burns in a metal cage. Dried meats dangle from ceiling beams. Thin, pale leaves covered in symbols are scattered on his table. I take a for-k off of the table and sit. I rest.
target: 奇怪老男人…… 无声，在林里找到我。我往痛脚抹泥。眼对上他的，我低吼，露全牙。 他眼变大，然后大笑。慢慢走近，我起身想跑，可痛脚踩不了。他扔一条肉干。啊呼，好味！手放胸口，说「艾、布内德」。 下一个动作我懂，招手。转身走。我跛着跟，握紧宝石。 不，我没进屋。伤我的丑女人，屋也差不多。留外头，坐松针。 他拿熟蛋熟肉来。啊呼——！没吃过这么好！肉没毛，蛋没壳！盐……神秘草！啊呼！ 再端暖水、编织布，用动作说：脚放水，布擦。然后进屋。 现在，怪老头打呼睡了。不怕？不知道我能伤他？ 家闻起来像皮与烟。金属笼里小火烧，梁上挂肉干，桌上散着薄白叶，全是符号。 我拿桌上的叉——子，坐下，休息。
